Staff Vacancy
Wednesday, 29 July 2020
5720 Hits
Dean, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Sevagram invites applications for the following posts. The application on plain paper enclosed with the certified photocopies of educational qualification and experience must reach to the Dean, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Po. Sevagram, Dist Wardha 442102 latest by
8
th
August 2020
.
Posts:
1. Accountant  (2 – 1 SC, 1 OBC)
Qualification & Experience
: Minimum Graduation in Commerce from recognized University in India and certificate of proficiency in operating the computerized system and experience of more than 5 years and should have dealt with the maintenance of Books of Accounts like cash book, ledger, journal, stock-books and the process of scrutiny of bills and pay bills, drawing salaries, should have adequate knowledge about Income Tax Laws, Provident Fund, Professional Tax, etc. The candidate must have worked in an organization having an annual Turnover of Rs. 25 Crores and above. He should have knowledge of preparing a Budget, drawing the Profit / Loss Accounts, Balance Sheet, etc.
2.
Senior Clerk (2 – 1 SC, 1 OBC)
Qualification & Experience :
Must be a graduate from any recognized University in India with 5 years’ experience of working in Accounts Department in the Office of Medical College /  Educational Institutions or in a large hospital.
----------------------
Pay Scale:
As admissible under the rules of Kasturba Health Society
Age Limit
: Between 18 to 35 years for open category, between 18 to 43 years for reserved category
Note:
1. Suitable & experienced candidates can be considered for relaxation in age limit and qualification.
2. Decision of Selection Committee will be final.
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
